description: This file defines the TaxItem class, which extends OrderTotalItem and includes properties for label and tax rate, indicating it models a tax-related item in the system.

classes.name: TaxItem
classes.description: Represents a tax item with label and tax rate, extending OrderTotalItem.

methods.name: setLabel
methods.description: Sets the label for the tax item.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the label of the tax item.

methods.name: setTaxRate
methods.description: Associates a TaxRate object with this tax item.

methods.name: getTaxRate
methods.description: Retrieves the TaxRate associated with this tax item.
